overview: KLE BCA College, Belagavi is a premier institution under KLE Society offering a 3-year full-time BCA program focused on computer applications, software development, and IT fundamentals.
eligibility: Candidates must have passed 10+2 (PUC or equivalent) from a recognized board with Mathematics/Computer Science/Business Mathematics as one of the subjects, with a minimum aggregate of 45% (40% for reserved categories).
admission_process: Fill the online/offline application form available on the KLE Society website or college admission office.
Submit required documents along with the application form.
Attend counselling/interaction session at the college (if applicable).
Merit list is prepared based on 10+2 marks.
Selected candidates must pay the admission fee to confirm their seat.

fee_structure.tuition_fee_per_year: Approx. INR 45,000 - 60,000 (varies by category and year, please confirm with admission office)
fee_structure.other_charges: Library, laboratory, and development fees applicable as per college norms

contact.address: KLE Society's BCA College, Vidyanagar, Belagavi, Karnataka - 590010
contact.email: info@klebcabelagavi.edu.in (sample - verify with official college website)

placements: The college has a dedicated placement cell that facilitates internships and job placements with IT companies, focusing on skill development in programming, web development, and emerging technologies.
facilities: Library with technical books and journals

faq.question: What is the eligibility for BCA admission?
faq.answer: 10+2 pass with minimum 45% aggregate (40% for reserved category) with Mathematics or Computer Science as a subject.

faq.question: What is the duration of the BCA course?
faq.answer: The BCA course is a 3-year full-time program divided into 6 semesters.

faq.question: Is there an entrance exam for BCA admission?
faq.answer: Generally admission is merit-based on 10+2 marks; some years may include a college-level interaction or test. Please confirm with the admission office.

faq.question: What documents are required for admission?
faq.answer: 10th and 12th marks cards, TC, migration certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), Aadhar card, and passport size photos.
